subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: For this exact rebased head, is redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login proof required before merge, or are the focused gateway lifecycle regressions and normal checks sufficient?
rationale: Only a gateway owner can decide whether the remaining provider-level behavior must be proven in a real WeChat session; the contributor cannot access such a setup and no narrow code repair remains.

options.title: Require real WeChat proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted A+B QR-login run that shows account A remains online after account B triggers the account-index reload.

options.title: Waive provider proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused lifecycle regressions, build, typecheck, and completed required checks as sufficient evidence for this gateway-only change.

recommendation.title: Require real WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted A+B QR-login run that shows account A remains online after account B triggers the account-index reload.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline explicitly routes early gateway review attention to this person, making them the best available owner candidate for the proof standard.
